assessment: This paper will be of interest to a broad range of neurophysiologists as it provides insights into the regulation of presynaptic voltage-gated calcium channel abundance which largely determines presynaptic strength. The findings demonstrate that while VGCC biosynthesis does not play a major role in regulating VGCC abundance at AZs, both trafficking and recycling at active zones are important regulatory steps.
